description_en: Queries the result of applying a firewall template rule to simple application servers
description_zh: 查询防火墙模板规则应用结果信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-firewall-template-rules-apply-result --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --firewall-template-id ft-bcf1a7hrdq7170000 --task-id aft-ikgt0bynitvs30000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFirewallTemplateRulesApplyResult

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the firewall template
parameters.name: firewall_template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution to apply the template rule
parameters.name: task_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The error codes when the firewall template rule fails to be applied
ErrorCode.description_zh: 防火墙模板规则应用失败时的错误码

ErrorInfo.description_en: The error message that is displayed when the firewall template rule fails to be applied
ErrorInfo.description_zh: 防火墙模板规则应用失败时的错误信息
ErrorInfo.example: An error occurred while processing your request.

Port.description_en:
The port range. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<start port number>/\<end port number>. Example: `1024/1055`, which indicates that the port range of 1024 to 1055.

If you set RuleProtocol to ICMP, you must set Port to -1/-1
Port.description_zh:
端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055。

如果您设置的是ICMP协议，端口只能为-1/-1

Remark.description_en: The remarks of the firewall rule

RuleProtocol.description_en:
The transport layer protocol that the rule supports. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

TCP+UDP

ICMP
RuleProtocol.description_zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议

SourceCidrIp.description_en: The source address to which you want to grant access permissions. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
SourceCidrIp.description_zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围

Success.description_en:
The status of applying the firewall template rule to the simple application servers.

Pending: The template rule does not start to be applied to the simple application servers.

Applying: The template rule is being applied to the simple application servers.

Success: The template rule is successfully applied to the simple application servers.

PartFailed: The template rule fails to be applied to some simple application servers
Success.description_zh:
防火墙模板规则应用到实例的状态，可能值：

Pending：实例尚未开始绑定规则。
Applying：实例正在绑定规则。
Success：实例绑定规则成功。
PartFailed：实例存在绑定失败的规则
